description: Verify a before/after revision pair for preserved numbers, qualifiers, keep terms, and register drift (0 credits, no login required; read-only).

after.description: Revised draft text to verify against the original

allowAdded.description: Allow new numbers or dates in after that were not in before (default false)

before.description: Original source text prior to editing

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint for modality detection

keep.description: Exact terms or identifiers that must appear unchanged in after

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto

register.description: Expected writing register to guard against tone drift

strict.description: Fail verification on anti-degradation or cadence warnings in addition to dropped facts

name: dislop_verify
